translation.name: Xchiʼdxyi cuubi dxiohs nin bieʼgaluuʼyi daada Jesucristu (El Nuevo Testamento en el zapoteco de Chichicapan y en español)

book.name: San Lucas
book.title: Dxyiꞌdxyi raꞌ nin bacaꞌh San Lucas xcweenta Jesucristu

content: Biaꞌhan dxyiꞌdxyi raꞌ ba xa guunn raꞌ ba tin guinaꞌzu raꞌ ba Jesuhs
Ya laꞌh lañih paascu zeꞌgadzihn chin rahw raꞌ bwiinn Israel pahn nin ayi rahcachaꞌyi cun levadura,
ya bwiinn raꞌ nin rnabwaꞌ raꞌ laꞌh bixohza neezaa bwiinn raꞌ nin ruluuꞌyi xlehyi Moisehs cadxiꞌhyi raꞌ ba xa guunn raꞌ ba tin chiinn raꞌ ba laꞌh Jesuhs laasii rdxyihbi raꞌ ba bwiinn raꞌ.
Ya chiꞌchi guyuuꞌtii bwiinndxaaba nin laa Satanahs stoꞌ Judas nin laa gahca Iscariote, nee gahca laꞌh ba naa ba xpwiinn Jesuhs nin naa gadziꞌh bichiohpa xpwiinn Ñiꞌh,

ya bwiinn chi gwaguihtsi loh raꞌ bixohza raꞌ nin rnabwaꞌ loh raꞌ bixohza cun loh raꞌ daada nin rnabwaꞌ laꞌh guixaꞌga raꞌ nin rahpa guidoꞌ. Guñiꞌnee Judas laꞌh raꞌ ba xa guunn ba tin gutiꞌdxi ba laꞌh Jesuhs loh raꞌ ba.
Chiꞌchi biahxi raꞌ ba ya guhdzi raꞌ ba loh Judas guicaꞌha ba nuhn mweeyi sidela dxiuꞌn ba ntriehgu laꞌh Ñiꞌh pur mweeyi chi.
Chiꞌchi guziꞌguehlda Judas ya guzaꞌloh cadxiꞌhyi ba xa guunn ba gutiꞌdxi ba laꞌh Jesuhs loh raꞌ bwiinn chi mwedxi ralaꞌn tin ayi gacabwaꞌ raꞌ bwiinn.
Luulchima vehsa gudahwxchihnee Jesuhs laꞌh raꞌ xpwiinn Ñiꞌh
Badzihn dxyihlañih chin rahw raꞌ ba pahn nin ayi rahcachaꞌyi cun levadura bieꞌ rdxiinn raꞌ ba tuhbi lliꞌhyi ziga caa loh xchihtsi guehtu Moisehs,
chiꞌchi guxeꞌhla Jesuhs Pehdru cun Jwahn, rahbi Ñiꞌh loh raꞌ ba: ―Gulcheguiꞌhnnchaꞌyi xi guidaꞌwxchih nuꞌh nin naa xchih pascu.
Chiꞌchi gunabadxyiꞌdxyi raꞌ ba loh Ñiꞌh, rahbi raꞌ ba: ―¿Canehza xclaaꞌdzi luꞌh gachidiꞌhnnchaꞌyi nu guelwahw?
Chiꞌchi rahbi Jesuhs: ―Chin chuꞌtii tu lahda guihdxyi, zadxaꞌga tu tuhbi bwiinn nin nuꞌa tuhbi riiꞌ ñihsa; chiꞌchi chenaꞌhla tu ba hasta dxiuꞌgarii ba yihdzi ba,
chiꞌchi guinabadxyiꞌdxyi tu loh nin naan yihdzi Ñiꞌh, squii gahbi tu: “Nnaa Daada Mwehsu: ¿Canehza riaꞌhan cwaartu hasta gahwchihnee ba xpwiinn ba xchih pascu?”
Ya bwiinn chi lwehgusi guluuꞌyi ba hasta naa cwarturooꞌ nin nuu guiyaꞌ laꞌn naa liistula. Riꞌchi guiguihn tu nin guidaꞌwxchih nuꞌh.
Ya chin badzihn raꞌ ba riꞌchi, guyaa bareꞌcaa garaatiiꞌ nin guhdzi Jesuhs laꞌnriila. Chiꞌchi bwiꞌhnnchaꞌyi raꞌ ba xchih pascu.
Ya chin badzihn hohra, badzihnnee Jesuhs spaaldaa xpwiinn Ñiꞌh chiꞌchi gurih raꞌ ba gadiidxi mweella,
chiꞌchi rahbi Ñiꞌh loh raꞌ ba: ―Blaaca nasaa cayahwxchihneen laꞌh tu xchih pascu antes que naꞌh sacaziin cun gachiꞌhn,
nen xñaxgaaꞌhn loh tu ayiru gabiaꞌgarii gahwneꞌhn laꞌh tu xchih pascu galoh gadzihn dxyih gacan loh xquelrnabwaꞌ Dxiohs.
Chiꞌchi gucaꞌha Ñiꞌh tuhbi copa vihnnu, badiꞌhi Ñiꞌh guelzuxchilli loh Dxiohs, chiꞌchi rahbi Ñiꞌh: ―Gulgueeꞌ deeꞌ gulchiꞌzi gahcan loh lasaaꞌ tu,
nen ñaan loh tu ayiru gabiaꞌgarii gueeꞌneen laꞌh tu ñihsa uhva stuhbi galoh nin gadzihn xquel rnabwaꞌ Dxiohs.

Chiꞌchi gucaꞌha gahca Ñiꞌh tuhbi pahn, badiꞌhi Ñiꞌh guelzuxchilli loh Dxiohs, hohrachi gutaaꞌha Ñiꞌhn, gudxiꞌzi Ñiꞌhn loh raꞌ ba, chiꞌchi rahbi Ñiꞌh: ―Deeꞌ naa ziga tiꞌxihn nin gutiꞌdxiꞌhn loh guelguhchi xcweenta tu, ya squiiꞌ gahca guunn tu tin dxiagannastoꞌ tu naꞌh.

Ziꞌchi gahcaza bwiꞌhnnee Ñiꞌh copa chin guluhlla gudahwxchihnee Ñiꞌh laꞌh raꞌ ba, rahbi Ñiꞌh loh raꞌ ba: ―Vihnnu nin nuu laꞌn copa riiꞌ naa ziga rihn nin nuuꞌhuhn, nin guixiꞌhihn chin chiinn raꞌ ba naꞌh xcweenta tu, tin ziꞌchi gaca dxyiꞌdxyicuubi nin gusiaꞌhan Dxiohs cun bwiinn raꞌ nin bibwiꞌhiraꞌla.
Yannah gulguiaꞌha laꞌnaa bwiinn nin gutooꞌ naꞌh dziꞌbanee naaꞌhahn loh mweella riiꞌ,
nee guchii nahpa gutiꞌdxiloon trabahjw duxa, laasii naan Bwiinn nin guxeꞌhla Dxiohs nahpa zareꞌcaa garaa nin caa loh xchihtsi Dxiohs, ¡per prohbiza bwiinn nin gutooꞌ naꞌh!
Chiꞌchi guzoꞌbaloh canabadxyiꞌdxyi loh lasaaꞌ raꞌ ba, rahbi raꞌ ba: ―¿Chyuniꞌca guunn ziꞌca?
Cayuuꞌyidxyiꞌdxyi raꞌ ba chyuniꞌca naa bwiinn nin mahzi lasahca
Neezaa guzaꞌloh cayuuꞌyidxyiꞌdxyi raꞌ ba xcweenta chyu mahzi lasahca loh raꞌ ba;
chiꞌchi rahbi Jesuhs loh raꞌ ba: ―Rehyi raꞌ nin rnabwaꞌ loh raꞌ bwiinn nin ayi naa bwiinn Israel ruhnn nayaachi raꞌ ba nee xclaaꞌdzi raꞌ ba guiñiꞌ xpwiinn raꞌ ba loh raꞌ ba: “Bwiinn zaꞌca luꞌh”,

per laꞌh tu ayi gaca tu ziꞌchi, sino que nin mahzi lasahca loh tu ayi chiꞌhyi ba guiñiꞌ zaꞌca bwiinn xcweenta ba; mejor gusaꞌn ba zigachiꞌhzi guiñiꞌ bwiinn loh ba, nee nin mahzi rnabwaꞌ nahpa gaca ba ziga mooza tin mahziru gacanee ba lasaaꞌ ba.

¿Cuunn nin mahzi lasahca; ta bwiinn nin rzohba loh mweella rahw o bwiinn nin raziꞌlaaꞌdzi guelwahw? ¿Tayigah guchiidxiꞌh bwiinn nin rzohba loh mweella? Per naꞌh nicala rnabwaꞌn loh tu per laꞌndxaꞌga zigazi tuhbi bwiinn nin rniꞌhi xi rahw tu.
Laꞌh tu naa tu bwiinn raꞌ nin biaꞌhanee naꞌh gaduhbi gudiꞌdxiꞌhn trabahjw nin gudiꞌdxiꞌhn,
niꞌchin nin guniꞌhihn guelrnabwaꞌ laꞌh tu ziga baniꞌhi Xpaaꞌnñin naꞌh,
tin gahw tu guee tu cwih tu loh xmweeꞌllahn llaaꞌn dxibaaꞌ, soobaa gahca tu loh yagaxiiyi bwiinn nin rnabwaꞌ tin guunn tu guelguxchiisi loh gadziꞌh bichiohpa cwaꞌh xjwamihyi Israel.
Basiaꞌhan Jesuhs dxyiꞌdxyi guiñiꞌ Pehdru ayi nuꞌnbwaꞌtiiꞌ bi laꞌh Ñiꞌh
Chiꞌchi rahbi Jesuhs loh Simohn: ―Simohn, Simohn; laꞌbwiinndxaaba nin laa Satanahs gunaaba yiꞌh tin tsiibi ba yiꞌh zigazi rbiꞌbi llooba chin nuuꞌhun deh,
per naꞌh laꞌn gunaaba loh Dxiohs pur yiꞌh tin ayi cweꞌhestoꞌ luꞌh xchiꞌdxyi Dxiohs, ya chin gabiaꞌgarii luꞌh loh Dxiohs, chiꞌchi gacanee raꞌ luꞌh lasaaꞌ luꞌh tin dxiaꞌhannee raꞌ ba xchiꞌdxyi Dxiohs.
Chiꞌchi rahbi Pehdru loh Ñiꞌh: ―Daada, laꞌnzuu liistula tin dxieꞌwneꞌhn yiꞌh, nicala gachiza nuꞌh.
Chiꞌchi rahbi Jesuhs loh ba: ―Pehdru, nnah gahca ñaan loh luꞌh galoh gucaꞌyahnn dxiidxinguhla, guiñiꞌ luꞌh mas chohnna bweelta ayi nuꞌmbwaꞌtiiꞌ luꞌh naꞌh.
Amweerla gadzihn hohra nin tiidxi Jesuhs trabahjw

Chiꞌchi gunabadxyiꞌdxyi Jesuhs loh raꞌ ba, rahbi Ñiꞌh: ―Chin guxeꞌhlaꞌhn laꞌh tu bagaluuꞌyi tu laꞌh raꞌ bwiinn xchiꞌdxyi Dxiohs, ayi gwanee tu buxa, nin dxihdximweeyi nin tuhbi tahgaza tahba tu, ¿ta guyuuꞌ xiilla biaꞌdxyi tu? Chiꞌchi rahbi raꞌ ba: ―Lliitiiꞌ.
Chiꞌchi rahbi Ñiꞌh: ―Per nnah ñaan loh tu, nin nahpa buxa, chenee ban; nin nahpa dxihdximweeyi, cheneezaa ban; nin ayi nahpa spahda, gutooꞌ ba xchiquehta ba tin siꞌ ba tuhbin;

tin rñaan loh tu nahpa gaca ziga caa loh Xchihtsi Dxiohs pur naꞌh; rñiꞌ dxyiꞌdxyi raꞌ chi: “Batiꞌdxi raꞌ ba laꞌh ba hasta nuu raꞌ bwiinn mahla.” Garaa nin caa loh xchihtsi Dxiohs pur naꞌh nahpa gacan.
Chiꞌchi rahbi raꞌ ba loh Ñiꞌh: ―Daada, riiꞌ laꞌchiohpa spahda nuuꞌ. Chiꞌchi rahbi Ñiꞌh loh raꞌ ba: ―Cun sola niꞌcasi zahlda, ayi xchiꞌhn ziahan.
Gudihdxyi-gunaaba Jesuhs loh Xtaada Ñiꞌh loh weerta nin laa Getsemanii
Chiꞌchi biriaꞌh Jesuhs zee Ñiꞌh loh dahan nin laa Olivo laasii ziꞌchi naa xcostumbre Ñiꞌh zenaꞌhlagah xpooxtla Ñiꞌh laꞌh Ñiꞌh,
ya chin badzihn raꞌ ba riꞌchi, chiꞌchi rahbi Ñiꞌh loh raꞌ ba: ―Gulguinaaba loh Dxiohs tin ayi gusaguiꞌhi bwiinndxaaba laꞌh tu.

Chiꞌchi biriaꞌcaa Jesuhs tuhbi lahdu hasta rii raꞌ ba, zigachiꞌh hasta radzihn tuhbi dxiah nin rucaꞌh bwiinn, chiꞌchi bazuꞌnllihbi Ñiꞌh riꞌchi tin gudihdxyi-gunaaba Ñiꞌh loh Xtaada Ñiꞌh nin naa Dxiohs,
squiiꞌ: ―Paah, ¿tayi gaca guchaꞌh xigaaba luꞌh tin guhldaꞌh luꞌh naꞌh loh trabahjw duxa nin gutiꞌdxiloon? Per sidela ayi nuuꞌhun, ayiza xi ruhnn tiꞌdxiꞌhñin.
Chiꞌchi baluuꞌyiloh tuhbi aanjla nin guxeꞌhla Xtaada Ñiꞌh tin gacanee Ñiꞌh laꞌh Jesuhs guunn Ñiꞌh waanta gutiꞌdxiloh Ñiꞌh trabahjw chi,
ya pur taantu nin cadiiꞌdxi Ñiꞌh trabahjw, niꞌchin nin mahzi cabwihdxyi Ñiꞌh loh Xtaada Ñiꞌh nee taantu nin cayahcanaꞌyi Ñiꞌh pur gota ñihsa cayaaba loh yuh gota chi rñahan ziga rihn.

Ya chin guyaꞌloh gudihdxyi-gunaaba Ñiꞌh loh Xtaada Ñiꞌh, chiꞌchi gwasuꞌnchii Ñiꞌh tin gwaguiaꞌha Ñiꞌh cuun raꞌ xpwiinn Ñiꞌh, ya chin badzihn Ñiꞌh riꞌchi bwaꞌha Ñiꞌh laꞌ raꞌ ba naꞌxgahsi pur guelnalaasa nin nuu stoꞌ raꞌ ba,
chiꞌchi rahbi Jesuhs loh raꞌ ba: ―¿Xixnaa naꞌxgahsi tu? Gulchestii gulguinaaba loh Dxiohs tin ayi gusaguiꞌhi bwiinndxaaba laꞌh tu.
Chin binaꞌzu Jesuhs

Gaduhbi cañiꞌ gahca Jesuhs loh raꞌ xpwiinn Ñiꞌh, badzihn ziahan bwiinn hasta rii raꞌ ba, delanta loh raꞌ ba ñiidxiuu tuhbi bwiinn nin laa Judas xpwiinn gahca Jesuhs laꞌh ba, chiꞌchi gwabiiga ba hasta zuu Jesuhs tin bachaꞌgarwaꞌ ba loh Ñiꞌh.
Chiꞌchi rahbi Jesuhs loh ba: ―Judas, ¿ta pur tuhbi behsu riiꞌ riuꞌn luꞌh ntriehgu Lliiꞌn Dxiohs nin naa ndxiꞌhw loh raꞌ bwiinn riiꞌ?
Ya chin bwaꞌha raꞌ xpwiinn Ñiꞌh nin rii gadiidxi Ñiꞌh nin cayahca riꞌchi, chiꞌchi gunabadxyiꞌdxyi raꞌ ba loh Jesuhs, rahbi raꞌ ba: ―Daada, ¿ta zadiꞌhigoolpi nu laꞌh raꞌ bwiinn ca cun spahda?
Chiꞌchi bachyuuꞌga tuhbi xpwiinn Jesuhs dxiahga tuhbi xmooza bwiinn nin rnabwaꞌ loh raꞌ bixohza, bachwaꞌha ba tuhbi lahdu dxiahga derehchu bi,
chiꞌchi rahbi Jesuhs loh raꞌ xpwiinn Ñiꞌh: ―¡Gulgasaaꞌn ba! ¡Cun sol niꞌca! Chiꞌchi badxiꞌhyi Jesuhs dxiahga mooza chi bachiꞌdxu Ñiꞌhn talguꞌnsi biaca zaꞌcan,

chiꞌchi guñiꞌ gahca Jesuhs loh raꞌ bwiinn nin rnabwaꞌ loh raꞌ bixohza neezaa bwiinn raꞌ nin naa guixaꞌga xteenn guidoꞌ neezaa bwiinnguuhla raꞌ nin zeꞌ tin chenee raꞌ ba laꞌh Ñiꞌh, rahbi Ñiꞌh: ―Xluuꞌyi nee spahda cun garrohta nuꞌa tu zeꞌ tu ziga chin guinaꞌzu tu tuhbi gubaꞌn,
¿xixnaa chin guyuꞌneꞌhn laꞌh tu laꞌn guidoꞌ garaa dxyih ayi gunaꞌzu tu naꞌh?, per nnahyi bigaꞌha xohra tu guunn tu nin xclaaꞌdzi bwiinndxaaba gaca.
Guhdzi Pehdru ayi nuꞌnbwaꞌtiiꞌ bi Jesuhs
Chiꞌchi gunaꞌzu raꞌ ba laꞌh Jesuhs tin zenee raꞌ ba laꞌh Ñiꞌh yihdzi bixohza nin rnabwaꞌ loh garaa raꞌ bixohza, cun nee Pehdru naꞌhlazihtu laꞌh raꞌ ba,
ya chin badzihn raꞌ ba riꞌchi, chiꞌchi gulahchi raꞌ ba dxih gadiidxin tin babihdxyi raꞌ ba; nee Pehdru dxaꞌga loh raꞌ ba.
Ya chin bwaꞌha tuhbi gunnaꞌh nin ruhnn dziꞌn riꞌchi zohba gabihdxyi Pehdru, chiꞌchi bwaꞌha-bwaꞌha bi loh Pehdru, chiꞌchi rahbi bi: ―¡Nee ndxiꞌhw riiꞌ naa xpwiinn Jesuhs!
Per Pehdru ayi gudxixteeꞌ bi nuꞌnbwaꞌ bi Jesuhs, rahbi bi: ―Gunnaꞌh, ayi nuꞌnbwaꞌn ba.

Ya snuhnsi rahca, guriin bwiinn lagaꞌh nin bwaꞌha laꞌh Pehdru, chiꞌchi rahbi ba: ―¡Cun neezaa luꞌh naa tuhbi raꞌ xpwiinn Jesuhs! Per Pehdru rahbilagaꞌh ba: ―Ñaan loh luꞌh daada, ayi needxiꞌhn naan xpwiinn ba.
Ya guhca mahs tuhbi hohra badzihn stuhbi bwiinn guzaꞌloh cañiꞌ ba, rahbi ba: ―¡Guchiin, nee bwiinn riiꞌ guyuꞌnee ba nen cun neezaa laasii naa ba tuhbi bwiinn Galilea!
Chiꞌchi rahbi Pehdru loh ba: ―Per daada, ¡ayi rahcabwaꞌn xiniꞌca nugazeꞌta luꞌh! Ya hohra gahca nin cañiꞌ Pehdru bacaꞌyahnn tuhbi dxiidxinguhla,

chiꞌchi basiaꞌgarii loh Jesuhs bwaꞌha Ñiꞌh loh Pehdru, chiꞌchi bagannastoꞌ Pehdru dxyiꞌdxyi nin guñiꞌ Jesuhs loh ba: “Galoh nin gucaꞌyahnn dxiidxinguhla nnadxyih, guiñiꞌ luꞌh loh raꞌ bwiinn chohnna bweelta gahbi luꞌh ayi nuꞌnbwaꞌtiiꞌ luꞌh naꞌh”,
chiꞌchi bariaꞌh Pehdru guzaꞌloh cayuꞌn bi nalaasa duxa.
Guñiꞌyah raꞌ ba laꞌh Jesuhs
Ya bwiinn raꞌ nin canee laꞌh Jesuhs guzaꞌloh cagallihdzinee raꞌ ba laꞌh Ñiꞌh neezaa cagadiꞌhigoolpi raꞌ ba laꞌh Ñiꞌh,
neezaa basieꞌw raꞌ ba loh Ñiꞌh chiꞌchi gudahpa raꞌ ban, rahbi raꞌ ba: ―Pwihsi yiꞌh ziga naa luꞌh Crixtu, ¡guhcabwaꞌ chyuñin nin gudahpa loh luꞌh!
Neezaa caguii xaꞌta raꞌ ba loh Ñiꞌh cañiꞌyah duxa raꞌ ba laꞌh Ñiꞌh.
Gwanee raꞌ ba Jesuhs loh bixohza raꞌ tin guunn raꞌ ba guelguxchiisi xcweenta Ñiꞌh

Ya chin barah gueꞌla, badiaaꞌha raꞌ bwiinnguuhla nin rnabwaꞌ neezaa bwiinn raꞌ nin rnabwaꞌ loh bixohza raꞌ neezaa bwiinn raꞌ nin ruluuꞌyi xlehyi Moisehs; gwanee raꞌ ba laꞌh Jesuhs, chiꞌchi rahbi raꞌ ba loh Ñiꞌh:
―Sidela guchii luꞌh naa luꞌh Crixtu, chixteeꞌ luꞌh loh nu. Chiꞌchi guñiꞌ Jesuhs loh raꞌ ba, rahbi Ñiꞌh: ―Sidela guiñaan, “Uhn”, ayi chechiistoꞌ tu naꞌh;
ya sidela guinaꞌbadxyiꞌdxyiꞌhn loh tu, ayi gusiaꞌgarii tu dxyiꞌdxyi,
per deznnah laꞌLliiꞌn Dxiohs nin naa ndxiꞌhw soobaa nehz lahdu derehchu cweeꞌ Dxiohs nin nuu llaaꞌndxibaaꞌ.
Chiꞌchi gunaabadxyiꞌdxyi garaa raꞌ ba, rahbi raꞌ ba loh Ñiꞌh: ―¿Tayichiꞌh naa luꞌh Lliiꞌn Dxiohs? Chiꞌchi rahbi Jesuhs loh raꞌ ba: ―Laꞌh gahca tu nnah tu naan ziꞌchi.

Chiꞌchi laꞌ gahca raꞌ ba rahbi loh lasaaꞌ raꞌ ba: ―¿Xi xclaaꞌdzi tu nnah? Ayiru xchiꞌhn guiñiꞌru bwiinn ca laasii laꞌh gahca nuꞌh bihn nuꞌh dxyiꞌdxyi raꞌ nin guñiꞌ ba, ¡ya dxyiꞌdxyi chi gahca guunn guelguxchiisi laꞌh ba!
